'''Retash''' is place that lies in a cluster of islands leagues off the [[Westlands|mainland]]. It is rarely visited by even the [[Sea Folk]], but is known for the drink, [[Retashen Dazer]]. {{ref/book|twotc|Retash}}

Their infamous drink is mentioned in a conversation between [[Androl]] and [[Nalaam]] at the [[Black Tower]]. Androl claims that he has visited once and had the drink on a bet. {{Ref/book|13|46}}
